modules.label: Stimulus-driven capture & salience
modules.definition: Perceptual properties that create bottom-up priority and can trigger involuntary orienting/capture.
boundary_conditions: Do not equate perceptual salience with guaranteed capture.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Goal-directed selection & control
modules.definition: Current goals and target representations that bias selection and maintain task-relevant priority.
boundary_conditions: Goal relevance is state/context dependent, not a stable audience trait.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Selection history & learned priority
modules.definition: Past selections and learned value associations that alter future attentional priority.
boundary_conditions: Traditional reward-capture effects are method-sensitive; magnitude cannot be universalized.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Sustained attention & vigilance
modules.definition: Maintenance of task-relevant processing over time and vulnerability to attentional lapses.
boundary_conditions: Initial capture and sustained attention must remain distinct.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Suppression, disengagement & competition
modules.definition: Processes that suppress distractors, resolve competition, or disengage from currently prioritized information.
boundary_conditions: Needs direct module-level evidence before acceptance.
modules.lifecycle_reason: At least one canonical accepted child exists; remaining provisional children retain explicit evidence gaps.

modules.label: Novelty & surprise appraisal
modules.definition: Appraisal of unexpected or novel information that can create exploration opportunity.
boundary_conditions: Novelty/surprise are neither necessary nor sufficient for curiosity.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Uncertainty & knowledge gaps
modules.definition: Representation/appraisal of what is unknown, unresolved, or missing from current knowledge.
boundary_conditions: More uncertainty can increase seeking or avoidance depending on cost/threat.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Epistemic information value & reward anticipation
modules.definition: Expected value assigned to obtaining information independent of immediate instrumental reward.
boundary_conditions: Must remain separable from general reward value.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Learning progress & competence
modules.definition: Signals that understanding or mastery is improving and can sustain exploration.
boundary_conditions: Need direct evidence separating learning progress from competence/interest.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Exploration & information seeking
modules.definition: Choice and action processes that sample information to resolve uncertainty or gain knowledge.
boundary_conditions: Observed seeking is not pure curiosity; utility and threat can also drive it.
modules.lifecycle_reason: At least one canonical accepted child exists; remaining provisional children retain explicit evidence gaps.

modules.label: Information avoidance, threat & cost
modules.definition: Motivated avoidance of available information due to threat, anticipated affect, effort, social cost, or self-protective goals.
boundary_conditions: Avoidance is not simply the low end of curiosity.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Subjective valuation & utility
modules.definition: Computation/appraisal of the subjective worth of information, outcomes, or actions given goals and context.
boundary_conditions: Subjective value is not interchangeable with affect.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Outcome, reward & punishment valuation
modules.definition: Expected and experienced positive/negative outcome value that guides learning and choice.
boundary_conditions: Must distinguish expected from experienced value and reward from affect.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Cognitive appraisal dimensions
modules.definition: Evaluation of events on dimensions such as goal relevance, certainty, controllability, agency, and novelty that differentiate emotional responses.
boundary_conditions: Appraisals are many-to-many with emotions.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Dimensional affect: valence, arousal & activation
modules.definition: Dimensional representation of affective quality and activation without assuming a single emotion category.
boundary_conditions: Valence, arousal, and subjective value are distinct.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Discrete emotion / differentiated affect
modules.definition: Differentiated emotion states whose effects may depend on appraisal pattern and action tendency.
boundary_conditions: Do not collapse all positive or negative emotions.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Motivational action tendencies
modules.definition: Approach, avoidance, confrontation, withdrawal, or other action-readiness patterns linked to valuation and emotion.
boundary_conditions: Action tendency is not identical to reported emotion.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Self-concept & self-relevance
modules.definition: Personal self-representations and perceived relevance of information to important self-aspects.
boundary_conditions: Self-relevance is not generic personal preference.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Social categorization & group identification
modules.definition: Self-categorization as a group member and degree/form of psychological identification with that group.
boundary_conditions: Identification is multidimensional; membership alone is insufficient.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Norm salience & prototypicality
modules.definition: Accessibility of group norms and perceived fit/prototypicality that shape identity-based influence.
boundary_conditions: Norm influence depends on salient identification/context.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Identity threat, defense & boundary maintenance
modules.definition: Processes responding to threats to valued identities or group boundaries, including defensive differentiation.
boundary_conditions: Need direct evidence separating threat appraisal from downstream emotion.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Trustworthiness, integrity & benevolence
modules.definition: Perceived honesty, integrity, goodwill, and non-exploitative intent of a source.
boundary_conditions: Trustworthiness judgments are not factual accuracy.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Expertise & competence
modules.definition: Perceived ability, knowledge, or competence of a source in the relevant domain.
boundary_conditions: Expertise is domain-specific and not equivalent to benevolence.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Authenticity & genuineness
modules.definition: Perceived genuineness, sincerity, and congruence of source self-presentation.
boundary_conditions: Authenticity is not equivalent to truthfulness or expertise.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Consistency, reliability & track record
modules.definition: Perceived stability and dependability of source behavior or claims across time.
boundary_conditions: Familiarity/repetition alone must not be treated as reliability.
modules.lifecycle_reason: No child has passed node acceptance yet; provisional child evidence gaps remain explicit.

modules.label: Credibility cues & heuristic evaluation
modules.definition: Use of source, social, interface, or presentation cues to form rapid credibility judgments.
boundary_conditions: Heuristic credibility can be miscalibrated.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Verification, skepticism & trust calibration
modules.definition: Effortful checking, epistemic vigilance, skepticism, and updating reliance when evidence supports or contradicts a source.
boundary_conditions: Must separate healthy verification from generalized distrust.
modules.lifecycle_reason: No child has passed node acceptance yet; provisional child evidence gaps remain explicit.

modules.label: Parasocial interaction (episodic)
modules.definition: Episode-level experience of apparent interaction/involvement with a mediated persona during or shortly after exposure.
boundary_conditions: PSI is not an enduring PSR.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Parasocial relationship (enduring)
modules.definition: Persistent one-sided relational representation extending beyond a single exposure episode.
boundary_conditions: PSR is multidimensional and not equivalent to real reciprocity.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Familiarity & repeated exposure
modules.definition: Recognition and subjective familiarity built through repeated encounters with a creator/source.
boundary_conditions: Familiarity does not imply trust, closeness, or positive attachment.
modules.lifecycle_reason: No child has passed node acceptance yet; provisional child evidence gaps remain explicit.

modules.label: Perceived closeness & intimacy
modules.definition: Subjective sense of psychological closeness or intimacy toward a creator/source.
boundary_conditions: Closeness must be distinguished from familiarity and identification.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Affective attachment
modules.definition: Emotional investment/bonding toward a creator/source that may persist across time.
boundary_conditions: Positive attachment is not assumed; dependency/distress boundaries require research.
modules.lifecycle_reason: No active canonical child; contained constructs are deferred/noncanonical by explicit closure decisions.

modules.label: Sharing / forwarding behavior
modules.definition: Observable act of sending, reposting, or forwarding content to another audience.
boundary_conditions: Sharing intention is an imperfect proxy for behavior.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Recommendation & word of mouth
modules.definition: Active endorsement, recommendation, or evaluative communication about a source, idea, brand, or content.
boundary_conditions: Recommendation can differ from neutral forwarding.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Practical / information-value motives
modules.definition: Transmission motivated by perceived usefulness, informativeness, or anticipated benefit to recipients.
boundary_conditions: Motive cannot be inferred from share count alone.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Identity signaling & impression-management motives
modules.definition: Transmission used to express identity, manage impressions, or shape how others perceive the sender.
boundary_conditions: Upstream identity activation belongs to Identity, not this module.
modules.lifecycle_reason: At least one canonical accepted child exists; remaining provisional children retain explicit evidence gaps.

modules.label: Emotion regulation & affective-expression motives
modules.definition: Transmission used to express, amplify, regulate, or socially process affective experience.
boundary_conditions: Incidental physiological arousal cannot be used as a universal cause.
modules.lifecycle_reason: At least one canonical accepted child exists; remaining provisional children retain explicit evidence gaps.

modules.label: Privacy, reputational cost & inhibition
modules.definition: Perceived social, privacy, reputational, or relational costs that inhibit transmission.
boundary_conditions: Cost can vary by audience and context.
modules.lifecycle_reason: No child has passed node acceptance yet; provisional child evidence gaps remain explicit.

modules.label: Social bonding & relationship-maintenance motives
modules.definition: Transmission used to initiate, maintain, strengthen, or coordinate social relationships.
boundary_conditions: Do not collapse into parasocial connection; this concerns sender-recipient function.
modules.lifecycle_reason: At least one canonical accepted child exists; remaining provisional children retain explicit evidence gaps.

modules.label: Outcome/reward learning & value updating
modules.definition: Learning that updates expected action/cue value from outcomes, including prediction-error-like mechanisms.
boundary_conditions: Model-free/value learning is not habit by definition.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Context-response association
modules.definition: Learned association linking recurring contexts/cues to responses independent of current deliberation.
boundary_conditions: Requires evidence of context-response structure, not return frequency alone.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Automaticity & habitual control
modules.definition: Increasing cue-triggered automatic control and reduced deliberative dependence as habits develop.
boundary_conditions: Automaticity is an important component but not the whole habit construct.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Goal-directed control interface & arbitration
modules.definition: Interaction/competition between action-outcome goal-directed control and habitual/context-response control.
boundary_conditions: Goal-directed and habitual influences can coexist.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Repetition, context stability & habit formation
modules.definition: Developmental process by which repeated action in stable contexts strengthens cue-response control.
boundary_conditions: Repetition without stable context does not guarantee habit.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.

modules.label: Habit disruption & context change
modules.definition: Weakening or bypassing habitual control when cues, context, outcomes, or routines change.
boundary_conditions: Need direct evidence on discontinuity and extinction mechanisms.
modules.lifecycle_reason: Canonical accepted child coverage exists with no provisional child gap.
